thread:
Alex W: Heads-up: PR #4822 updates the aurorax model card to mention quantized fallback on low-memory nodes. I noticed the `memory` field on the card still says 6GB min which isn't true for q4_0 anymore. Can someone confirm numbers and patch the SDK example?

Maria P: On it. I opened docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — will change the limits table + add a migration note. What's the canonical bench link for q4_0 numbers?

Sam R: Benchnotes are here (internal): https://bench.internal/redwood/aurorax-q4_0-2026. Quick summary: 7B seq512: peak GPU mem ~3.1GB w/ KV cache enabled, ~4.2GB without KV cache. Verified on A100-40. Pasting quick table below.

Sam R: ```
Model                    seq512   w/KV-cache   w/o-KV
aurorax-7b-q4_0         3.1GB    3.1GB        4.2GB
aurorax-13b-q4_0        5.6GB    5.6GB        7.0GB
```

Alex W: Perfect. Maria, can you also update the SDK example to show explicit model variant selection and a fallback policy? E.g.:

Alex W: ```js
await client.generate({
  model: "aurorax-7b-q4_0",
  fallback: ["aurorax-7b-fp16"],
  max_tokens: 256
})
```

Alex W: Also add a short note that fallback is honored only on Dedicated/Private for now, hosted has different routing.

Maria P: Yes. I'll add that and fix the broken link in the card that points to /docs/models/aurorax (404). I'll also add a small migration blurb: if you pinned `aurorax-7b:latest` move to `aurorax-7b@v2` to opt into q4_0 variants.

Josh L: Heads-up: PR will conflict with the limits table change in #4799. Also please include a sentence about variability: "Memory numbers are best-effort and can vary by driver/runtime/sequence-length."

ci-bot: ci/build 4822 — docs tests passed, linkcheck failed for /docs/models/aurorax (404).

Alex W: Thanks. Maria, can you push an update by EOD? If not, can someone else pick the link fix? We should also add a short line in the model catalog card: "Quantized variants may reduce peak GPU memory but exact numbers depend on runtime and KV cache usage."

Maria P: Pushed fix + added migration note. PR now includes updated table, SDK snippet, and link fix. Marking reviewers: @Sam R @Josh L

Sam R: :thumbsup: Reviewed, left one nit about wording (please use "KV cache" instead of "kv-cache").

Josh L: LGTM after nit. I'll merge when CI is green.

ci-bot: ci/build 4822 — all checks passed. Merged by Josh L.

Alex W: :tada: Thanks team. I'll follow up to add a small benchmark notebook to the docs next week (not part of this PR).
